commuters.name: Walter Bix
commuters.title: Baker
commuters.shrug: Couldn't tell you. I'm a baker, not a detective.

commuters.name: Clementine Rook
commuters.title: Typist
commuters.shrug: Oh! I — I'm not sure. Sorry.

commuters.name: Reggie Stokes
commuters.title: Businessman
commuters.shrug: Let's not get bogged down in details, squire.

commuters.name: Mrs Odile Marsh
commuters.shrug: Oh, my memory, dear. It comes and goes, like trains.

commuters.name: Constable Bramble
commuters.title: Station Police
commuters.shrug: No idea, I'm afraid. Not my department.

commuters.name: Rosalind Fairweather
commuters.title: Twin
commuters.shrug: I couldn't say. Cecily?

commuters.name: Cecily Fairweather
commuters.title: Twin
commuters.shrug: Haven't the foggiest. Rosalind?

commuters.name: Hugo Haversham
commuters.title: Accountant
commuters.shrug: I — er — that is to say — I don't recall.

commuters.name: Mr Vell
commuters.title: The Grey Gentleman
commuters.shrug: Does it matter? It's mine. Everything lost is a little bit mine.

commuters.name: Pip Okafor
commuters.title: Schoolgirl
commuters.shrug: Dunno! I'm only ten.

commuters.name: Dora Finch
commuters.title: Turf Accountant
commuters.shrug: Search me, love.

commuters.name: Harriet Lowe
commuters.shrug: I don't know. I'm sorry.

commuters.name: Victor Crane
commuters.title: Antiques Dealer
commuters.shrug: Irrelevant. I have documentation.

commuters.name: Thomas Hale
commuters.shrug: I couldn't say. Everything's a bit... out of focus, lately.

commuters.name: Lt. Arthur Penhallow
commuters.shrug: Forgive me. I don't remember everything any more.

commuters.name: Big Sid Mulroney
commuters.title: Platelayer
commuters.shrug: Couldn't tell you, pal.

commuters.name: Lou Delacroix
commuters.title: Musician
commuters.shrug: Man, it was a long night.

commuters.name: Vernon Spratt
commuters.title: Musician
commuters.shrug: Why would I know that? Er — I mean, yes. Probably.

commuters.name: Edie Larkspur
commuters.title: Actress
commuters.shrug: Darling, I simply don't do details.

commuters.name: Mr Ezra Plum
commuters.shrug: Can't see a thing, you see. That's rather the point.

commuters.name: Prof. Ambrose Lark
commuters.title: Ornithologist
commuters.shrug: Hm. Outside my field, I'm afraid.

commuters.name: Agnes
commuters.shrug: Oh, love. You know more than I do now.

commuters.name: Thomas
commuters.shrug: Ask Agnes. She remembers everything.
